steps.title: Make Collagenase P digestion solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.45 mg/mL Collagenase P solution by adding 0.45 mg Collagenase P to 20 mL DMEM (99.5 % DMEM) and 100 µL 1 M CaCl₂ to reach 2 mM Ca²⁺; mix well and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M CaCl₂ stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.655 g CaCl₂ in 15 mL deionized water to obtain a 1 M CaCl₂ solution; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Make 1× RBC lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 1 mL 10× RBC lysis buffer with 9 mL ddH₂O, equilibrate to room temperature, and use during the RBC lysis step.

steps.title: Prepare FACS buffer
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL fetal bovine serum to 50 mL PBS (final 1.5 % FBS); mix and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Euthanize mice and dissect adipose depots
steps.instruction: Clean mouse with 70 % ethanol, euthanize per approved method, re‑clean carcass, dissect epididymal white adipose tissue (eWAT) and inguinal WAT (iWAT) (≥2 g each) into cold PBS‑filled Petri dishes, avoiding lymph nodes and vessels.

steps.title: Optional cardiac perfusion for blood clearance
steps.instruction: Using a 10 mL syringe, perfuse PBS (optionally with 1–2 mM EDTA or 2 U/mL heparin) through the heart three times, make three small cuts in liver lobes, and wash tissue with PBS on ice to remove circulating blood; omit if RBC lysis is sufficient.

steps.title: Mince tissue into small fragments
steps.instruction: Using sterile scissors in RPMI, cut eWAT into ~1–2 mm pieces.

steps.title: Digest tissue with Collagenase P
steps.instruction: Transfer minced tissue to 20 mL Collagenase P solution, incubate at 37 °C with shaking at 200 rpm for ~50 min; after 30 min gently shake by hand, check every 10 min, and stop when no large fragments remain, yielding a uniform slurry.

steps.title: Stop enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL RPMI containing 10 % FBS to each tube and pipette to mix, terminating collagenase activity.

steps.title: Filter and centrifuge to collect SVF
steps.instruction: Pass the digested mixture through a 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube, then centrifuge at 700×g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Discard oil and adipocyte layers, retain SVF pellet
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the top oil layer and the middle aqueous layer; keep the reddish‑brown pellet (stromal vascular fraction) at the bottom.

steps.title: Resuspend SVF, filter, and re‑centrifuge
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the SVF pellet in sterile FACS buffer to obtain a single‑cell suspension, filter through a fresh 70 µm strainer into a new 50 mL tube, then centrifuge at 1,000×g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform RBC lysis on SVF
steps.instruction: Decant supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer, incubate at room temperature for 2 min, then proceed to quench.

steps.title: Quench RBC lysis and wash cells
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL RPMI + 2 % FBS (add 180 µL FBS to 9 mL RPMI), mix, centrifuge at 1,100×g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 1 mL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Filter clumps and optional cell count
steps.instruction: If aggregates are visible, pass the suspension through a 70 µm strainer, keep on ice, and optionally count cells using a Countess chamber.

steps.title: Set aside unstained control and aliquot cells
steps.instruction: Place 300 µL of cell suspension into an unlabeled tube on ice (keep 40–50 % of total cells for unstained control), then aliquot 1–2 × 10⁶ SVF cells per sample into FACS tubes.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Add anti‑CD16/CD32 antibody diluted 1:50 in 100 µL FACS buffer to each tube, incubate 20 min at 4 °C, then centrifuge at 1,000×g for 5 min and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: In FACS buffer, mix antibodies per 100 µL per million cells: F4/80‑FITC 1.5 µL, CD11b‑PE 1.25 µL, CD11c‑BV421 1.25 µL, CD206‑AF700 0.5 µL, CD9‑PE‑Dazzle594 1.25 µL, CD63‑PE‑Cy7 2.5 µL, Trem2‑APC 5 µL, CD45‑PerCP 3.75 µL.

steps.title: Stain cells with antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the prepared antibody cocktail to each cell pellet, incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash stained cells twice
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 500×g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant and repeat once more.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for acquisition
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 300 µL FACS buffer and filter through a 35 µm mesh if needed.

steps.title: Keep samples on ice before acquisition
steps.instruction: Transfer each 300 µL suspension into a labeled 5 mL Falcon tube, cover, and keep on ice until flow cytometry.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data with controls
steps.instruction: Run samples on a flow cytometer, including unstained, single‑color, and fluorescence‑minus‑one (FMO) controls as defined in Table 2, and apply proper compensation.

steps.title: Optional viability dye staining
steps.instruction: Add a live/dead dye (e.g., Zombie Aqua, DAPI, or PI) according to the manufacturer’s protocol before Fc block to exclude non‑viable cells.

steps.title: Gate out debris and doublets
steps.instruction: Use forward‑scatter (FSC) and side‑scatter (SSC) to exclude debris and doublets; no autofluorescence gating is applied.

steps.title: Identify macrophage subsets by markers
steps.instruction: Gate CD45⁺ leukocytes, then CD11b⁺F4/80⁺ macrophages; subclassify as CD11c⁺CD206⁻ (pro‑inflammatory), CD11c⁺CD206⁺ (intermediate), CD11c⁻CD206⁺ (alternatively activated); optionally gate CD9⁺, Trem2⁺, CD63⁺ subsets within macrophages.

steps.title: Sort macrophage populations into collection tubes
steps.instruction: Using the same gating hierarchy, sort each population into tubes pre‑coated with 0.5–1 mL FBS containing RPMI + 10 % FBS; keep tubes at 4 °C and proceed immediately to downstream assays (e.g., RNA isolation).

steps.title: Pre‑coat collection tubes with FBS
steps.instruction: Add ~0.5–1 mL fetal bovine serum to each collection tube, gently swirl to coat the inner surface, discard excess before sorting.
